questions.q: What is the programme mainly about?
options: How to clean windows safely on tall buildings
A man who survived a fall from a skyscraper
The tallest buildings in New York and their history
How firefighters rescue people from burning buildings
questions.why: They discuss miraculous survivals, mainly the story of window cleaner Alcides Moreno.

questions.q: What near-death experience has Neil had?
options: He fell out of a canoe into a fast river
He fell through a hole in a garage floor
He fell off a mountain and was saved by a tree
He was in a car crash on a mountain road
questions.why: Neil says he once fell off the side of a mountain but was saved by a tree.

options: Cleaning windows on New York skyscrapers
Building scaffolding for new skyscrapers
Working as a firefighter in New York
Working as a doctor in a city hospital
questions.why: Dan says he's a window cleaner who cleaned the windows on skyscrapers in New York.

questions.q: How far did Alcides and his brother fall?
options: 3 storeys
7 storeys
24 storeys
47 storeys
questions.why: Dan says both brothers fell 47 storeys.

options: One of them slipped on water on the platform
There was a strong wind high above the city
A window broke and they lost their balance
The cables holding the platform were loose
questions.why: Dan says the cables were loose and the scaffold fell from the building.

options: Lying on a fence next to the building, unconscious
Crouching in twisted metal, still holding the controls
Standing in the street, talking calmly to people
Hanging from the side of the building by a safety rope
questions.why: Jo Fidgen says he was crouching in twisted metal, clutching the controls, and breathing.

questions.q: What happened to Alcides after the fall?
options: He went home the same day with only a few cuts
He had no serious injuries and felt fine the next day
He was in a coma for three weeks and needed lots of blood
He went back to his job the next week, cleaning windows
questions.why: Dan says he fell into a coma for 3 weeks and needed 24 pints of blood.

questions.q: What did Dr Philip Barie say about Alcides's survival?
options: It had never happened before and was perhaps a miracle
It was quite common for falls like this in New York
It was because of the hospital's new treatment for burns
It was lucky, but easy to explain with simple science
questions.why: He called it unprecedented and extraordinary, and said a believer would call it a miracle.
